subject: Reference request: Nimbus Health — sandbox access & redaction guidance
body:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Catherine Liao <claio@gartner.com>, Jacob Rios <jrios@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-31T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Reference call + dev sandbox access (Nimbus Health)

Hi Catherine and Jacob,

Thanks again for agreeing to consider Nimbus Health as a reference for the upcoming Gartner note. I want to keep this light — two asks up front so we can scope next steps: 

1) Can we schedule a 45-minute reference call in the week of Nov 8? Jacob, what windows work for you?
2) Catherine, Gartner often requests a short technical sandbox/demo access for a technical reviewer prior to finalizing the write-up. Jacob, would Nimbus be comfortable with a time-limited dev sandbox containing anonymized sample data and read-only logs for the reviewer? We’ll provide a redaction checklist and a temporary account with strict access windows.

I attached our standard reference consent (nimbus_reference_waiver.pdf). If DocuSign is easier, we’ll send a link. If Jacob is okay with the sandbox idea, I’ll loop in David (CS engineering) for provisioning and Marissa (legal/comms) for redaction guidance.

Cheers,
Naomi
Director, Customer Advocacy | Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: nimbus_reference_waiver.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

-----Original Message-----
From: Jacob Rios <jrios@nimbushealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Catherine Liao <claio@gartner.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Reference call + dev sandbox access (Nimbus Health)

Hi Naomi and Catherine,

Thanks for reaching out. Happy to help — we value the relationship with Redwood.

Availability: Tue Nov 9 after 11am PT or Thu Nov 11 between 9–12 PT. Either works for a 45-minute call.

About the sandbox: We're willing to provide a temporary dev account, but we need clarity on the exact artifacts Gartner will access (types of logs, sample payloads). Also want an explicit redaction checklist and confirmation that no PHI will be shared.

I can sign a short waiver if needed but prefer DocuSign rather than PDFs attached.

Regards,
Jacob Rios
VP Product | Nimbus Health

-----
On Mon, Nov 1, 2027 at 11:05 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Jacob — looping in David (CS engineering) and Marissa (Legal/comms) to pick up the sandbox and redaction details.
> 
> David/Marissa: Jacob confirmed availability windows and is open to a time-limited dev account; he needs a list of exactly what Gartner will see and a redaction checklist.
> 
> Can David propose a minimum-privilege sandbox scope (read-only logs, telemetry, sample anonymized payloads) and an access expiration policy? Marissa, can you draft a brief checklist and indicate whether DocuSign is preferred for the waiver?
> 
> Thanks — Naomi
> 

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Jacob Rios <jrios@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-01T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Reference call + dev sandbox access (Nimbus Health)

Hi all,

I can provision a time-limited dev sandbox. Proposed scope:
- Account with read-only access to a pre-built demo workspace (no production PII)
- Synthetic/anonymized dataset derived from Nimbus test exports
- Access window: 7 days, single IP allowlist if Nimbus prefers
- No export of raw logs permitted; Gartner can view logs via UI only (we’ll provide session recordings if needed)

If that works, I’ll generate credentials and send them encrypted. I’ll also prepare a short runbook for the reviewer.

Jacob — can you confirm whether a single IP allowlist is acceptable and whether Nimbus prefers us to host the sandbox or if you want to host a copy in your environment (we can provide instructions either way).

Thanks,
David
Sr. Customer Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Jacob Rios <jrios@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Reference call + dev sandbox access (Nimbus Health)

Hi Jacob — quick note from Legal/Comms on best practices.

1) Redaction checklist (attached as redaction_checklist.xlsx): remove direct identifiers (names, emails, MRNs), mask any free-text notes that may include PHI, and replace real user IDs with synthetic IDs.
2) No PHI: Please confirm explicitly that production PHI will not be placed into the sandbox. If there is any uncertainty, we can run an automated scan on the data export.
3) Waiver/Consent: DocuSign powerform link here: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&formId=ABC123 — sign that and we’ll consider the consent in place.

Regarding hosting: If Nimbus prefers, we can host a read-only copy so no customer infrastructure changes are required. We will provide a secure, ephemeral account and enforce IP allowlisting and a 7-day expiration.

I attached a short checklist for your security team. Happy to hop on a quick 15-min technical call with your ops contact if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Advocacy Programs | Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: redaction_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)

-----Original Message-----
From: Catherine Liao <claio@gartner.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Jacob Rios <jrios@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: research_ops@gartner.com
Date: 2027-11-03T08:30:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: Reference call + dev sandbox access (Nimbus Health)

Thank you — that scope sounds sensible. I can take the sandbox reviewer role and will only access the anonymized/demo workspace as described. Two quick asks:

1) Please provide the runbook and a short list of the artifacts I should review ahead of our call (sample prompts, latency/cost profile, and a summary of the anonymization approach).
2) For audit purposes, can Redwood provide a short log excerpt showing reviewer access time and the data views the reviewer used (we understand redaction will remove identifying data).

I’m available for Nov 9 at 11:30am PT; that fits the window Jacob suggested. If that’s confirmed, we can lock the calendar and I’ll route a short questionnaire from Research Ops that we use for write-ups.

Regards,
Catherine Liao
Analyst — Cloud AI Platforms | Gartner

-----
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Catherine Liao <claio@gartner.com>, Jacob Rios <jrios@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Reference call + dev sandbox access (Nimbus Health)

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps: 

- Reference call: Tue Nov 9, 11:30am PT (45 minutes). I’ll send a calendar invite.
- David will provision a hosted read-only dev sandbox and deliver encrypted credentials to Jacob and Gartner on Nov 5.
- Marissa has shared the redaction checklist and DocuSign link; Jacob to sign waiver by Nov 4 if possible.
- David will provide a 1–2 page runbook and a 10-line log excerpt showing reviewer access for audit.

Jacob — let me know if Nimbus wants the sandbox hosted by Redwood or if you prefer to host the copy. If we don’t hear back by end of day Nov 4, we’ll assume Redwood-hosted sandbox and proceed with allowlist + 7-day window.

Appreciate the collaboration. Naomi
Director, Customer Advocacy | Redwood Inference

---
Attachments referenced: dev_sandbox_credentials.txt (to be sent encrypted on Nov 5), redaction_checklist.xlsx (attached above), nimbus_reference_waiver.pdf
